name: Ric's Restaurant Sports Lounge
bio: Ric's Restaurant & Sports Lounge is a family-owned restaurant and sports bar in Camarillo Village Square, with a patio, outdoor TVs and live entertainment.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @ricscamarillo and Visit Camarillo.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
